hero.title: A playground & café — for parents and kids
hero.description: A huge 3-floor indoor playground for kids aged 1–9. Sit back with the little ones and enjoy it too. A café, a private birthday room and a warm, welcoming team.

about.title: One place for the whole family
about.body: We believe you can be a parent and still enjoy a moment to yourself. So we built a big, beautiful space, with an all-day café alongside classes, workshops and birthdays — right next to a huge, well-equipped, secure and clean play area. All under one roof.

items.title: An inviting play area
items.description: A pleasant, well-designed space for babies, toddlers and kids

items.title: A café for parents
items.description: Coffee, sweets and snacks — for you and the kids, all day long

items.title: Classes & birthdays
items.description: Developmental classes, workshops, enrichment talks and celebrations

reassurance.title: Don't worry — we've got it all covered!
reassurance.body: Picked the kids up from daycare? Come straight to us. Spend quality time together, enjoy a healthy dinner, and head home for just a warm bath, a story and bed.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.note: * Admission covers one child and one guardian. Each additional guardian is +20 ₪. Daily entry.
rules: Admission covers one child and one guardian; each additional guardian is +20 ₪.
Daily entry — you can come and go throughout the day.
Children must be supervised by an adult aged 16 or over.

birthday.title: Celebrate a birthday at Baloona!
birthday.description: Two hours of fun with free access to the attractions, a private room, pizza for every child and a cake ceremony by our team. From 1,990 ₪ for 25 kids.

gallery.title: A little peek at the venue
